[
  "When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1-3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as lesions on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and on the genitalia.",
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness, as well as for melanoma in situ.",
  "Surgical margins should be based on tumor thickness.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor and in the same operative setting whenever possible.",
  "The criteria driving the 5‑point score are pigment_network (atypical, 2 points), pigmentation (diffuse irregular, 1 point), dots_and_globules (irregular, 1 point), and regression_structures (white areas, 1 point).",
  "These features are minor or major features associated with melanoma.",
  "On the image, verify the presence and morphology of an atypical pigment network (irregular meshes and thickened lines).",
  "On the image, verify diffuse irregular pigmentation.",
  "On the image, verify irregular dots or globules.",
  "On the image, verify white scar‑like regression structures.",
  "The absence of blue‑whitish veil, streaks, and atypical vascular structures (other than within regression) does not negate the high score driven by the other features."
]
